newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - JEVIC FILES FOR 3.8 MLN SHARES.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - JEVIC FILES FOR 3.8 MLN SHARES.

text.p: Jevic Transportation Inc filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an initial public offering of up to 3.8 million common shares, which it expects to sell between $12 and $14 each.

The Delanco, N.J., motor carrier company said it will use the proceeds from the sale to reduce outstanding debt, fund a special distribution to current shareholders and for other working capital needs.
Underwriters for the offering, Alex Brown & Sons, William Blair & Co and Schroder & Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 570,000 shares.
After the offering, the company will have 10,658,200 shares outstanding.
